about: Which series each morning's video comes from (read by next.py). pattern: one morning per entry, repeating from start: ["llm", "qc"] = alternate days, LLM first; ["qc"] = only the quantum series; ["llm", "llm", "qc"] = two LLM mornings, then one QC. llm = CSE 291P LLM System Optimization (syllabus.json), qc = CSE 291P Quantum Computing Systems (syllabus-qc.json). Mornings before start are LLM mornings. when_empty: "other" = a morning whose series has nothing left to make goes to the other series; "none" = that morning gets no video.
